feeds.title: RGK Dance Academy Blog
feeds.description: Renu founded RGK Modern Indian Dance Academy in 2004 to serve as a leading voice for exhilarating and beautiful Bollywood Inspired dance classes, Folk, Contemporary, Semi-Classical, and Modern Indian dance movements. This professional academy is acclaimed for its diverse and versatile artists, and students, performing work that draws together modern dance, Indian classical Kathak, Bharatnatyam, Folk, and Western dancing, like Salsa, hip-hop, Ballroom, and jazz.

feeds.title: Northland School of Dance
feeds.description: Northland School of Dance is a nationally recognized dance studio founded under the phenomenal leadership of Teresa Rolf, and has been family-owned & operated for 48 years. We offer dance classes in both recreational and competitive levels, for ages 2.5 - adult. Classes include jazz, tap, ballet, Pointe', lyrical, contemporary, hip hop, the acro, boy-only classes, special needs classes, adult classes, a full range of technique classes, and more!

feeds.title: Dance-Twirl Minnesota Blog
feeds.description: Dance-Twirl Minnesota was founded in 2002 by Owner and Director, Jacinda Miller. She started twirling when she was 6 years old, competing and performing throughout her youth. She continues to teach at Dance-Twirl Minnesota along with a team of dedicated professional teachers that love baton, dance and seeing children grow and learn as much as she does.

feeds.title: Minnesota Dance Theatre
feeds.description: Founded in 1962 by Loyce Houlton, Minnesota Dance Theatre & School is a flagship dance company in Minnesota, having achieved recognition both locally and abroad for performances that feature a range of classical and contemporary dance. Our mission is to present masterful and inspiring dance through performance and education.

feeds.title: Straightline Dance Fitness Blog
feeds.description: There's never a dull moment with our wide range of classes. Barre, Cardio Dance, Pop Pilates, Fascia Fitness, Ballet, Shuffle, Hip Hop, and more-we aim to inspire movement. Our workshops and training give you the opportunity to deepen your practice, broaden your mind, and share your love of movement with others.

feeds.title: Suzy and Hondo Blog
feeds.description: Suzy and Hondo are the definitions of a dynamic duo! They specialize in empowering small-town dancers, and dance teachers. They started their studio in 1998. They have many years of teaching under their belts. They truly can teach anyone how to dance. They approach each lesson with fresh eyes and tweak it to help everyone learn the best.
